issue.title: TS SDK unit tests do not run in pull request CI
issue.body:
The `ts-sdk` vitest suite runs only in `ts-sdk-release.yml` (`basic-tests.yml` runs `pnpm test` for the two UIs only), so a pull request that changes `ts-sdk/` is never unit-tested. Add a job (or a prek hook) that runs `pnpm test` for changes under `ts-sdk/`.

---

Drafted with Claude Code (Opus 5.5).
